title: Selective Posterior Margin Regularization for Forward-Corrected Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.05859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning with class-conditional label noise often relies on a transition model from latent clean classes to observed annotations. Forward correction embeds this transition in the likelihood, yet finite-sample networks may still memorize corrupted labels. The corrected likelihood also induces a reverse posterior over the clean classes that could explain each annotation. When its leading class differs from the annotation, the model and transition matrix provide evidence against that annotation, but the leading alternatives can remain nearly tied. We introduce Selective Posterior Margin Regularization (SPMR), which preserves the Forward objective and converts this disagreement into a graded update on the clean classifier. SPMR selects the leading reverse-posterior class, scales a detached pairwise margin by the separation between the two leading posterior classes, and assigns correspondingly little influence to diffuse conflicts. translated_title: 面向前向校正分类的选择性后验边际正则化
translated_abstract: 在类条件标签噪声下进行学习通常依赖于一个从潜在干净类别到观测标注的转移模型。前向校正将这种转移嵌入到似然中，然而有限样本的网络仍然可能记忆损坏的标签。校正后的似然还会诱导出一个关于干净类别的反向后验，该后验可以解释每个标注。当其主导类别与标注不一致时，模型和转移矩阵提供了反对该标注的证据，但主导的备选类别可能仍然几乎持平。我们提出了选择性后验边际正则化（SPMR），该方法保留前向目标函数，并将这种不一致转化为对干净分类器的分级更新。SPMR选择主导的反向后验类别，利用两个主导后验类别之间的间隔来缩放一个分离的成对边际，并对模糊冲突赋予相应较小的影响力。该差距...
tldr: 提出选择性后验边际正则化（SPMR），在保留前向校正目标的基础上，将反向后验主导类别与标注的不一致转化为按后验间隔分级缩放的成对边际更新，从而有效抑制网络对噪声标签的记忆。
en_tdlr: Proposes Selective Posterior Margin Regularization (SPMR), which preserves the forward correction objective and converts the disagreement between the leading reverse-posterior class and the annotation into a graded pairwise margin update scaled by posterior separation, effectively suppressing memorization of noisy labels.
